QuestInfo.name: Information Delivery
QuestInfo.0: #bEurenth#k is writing a letter. Talk to him.
QuestInfo.1: Return to the #bCommander Barracks#k and deliver #bEurenth's Letter#k to #bEdea#k.
QuestInfo.2: You delivered Eurenth's Letter to Edea.

0.0: Here. If your commander asks you what you got, tell her you got #b#i4036159:# #t4036159:##k. I wrote down everything you could possibly want to know.\r\n

0.msg: Finally, it's in my hands! My collection is complete! I'll find you a nice, cozy spot in the center of my display...\r\n

1.msg: #b(What he doesn't know is that the hand-stamp on this figurine is the personal hand-stamp of... a Yellow Speeyor. It serves him right.)#k\r\n

2.msg: #b(Anyway, it's time to return to Edea. Thank goodness this job is over with.)#k\r\n#r(You will automatically move to the relevant field.)#k

yes.0: I will admit, I was uncertain that you could complete this task. Even at a glance, I can tell this is filled with vital intelligence.\r\n
yes.1: Give me a moment to devise our new strategy. This won't take long.\r\n

default.0: #b(Now all you need to do is deliver Eurenth's letter to Edea. So much trouble for such a simple thing...)#k\r\n
